The '''Neuro-Saav Corporation Cyber-Scanner Arm''' was a model of [[cyberscanner arm]] made by [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] and sold for 4000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|limb]] was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
